en.text: Looking to hire a designer in Tbilisi for your brand, product, or next campaign? You're in the right place.

Bitz is a one-person studio covering branding, graphic design, 3D, motion, and UI/UX - so whether you need a branding agency in Tbilisi to build an identity from scratch, or a freelance UI/UX designer to take an existing product further, it's one point of contact instead of three separate hires. Recent work like the Credo Bank project and the portfolio show the range this covers, from brand identity through to shipped interfaces. Discovery - a short call or message to understand the project, timeline, and budget. Design and iteration - concepts, feedback rounds, and revisions until it's right. Delivery - final files, assets, or a handed-off interface, ready to use. Send a short brief through the form below, or reach out directly by email or phone. This is the fastest way to contact a designer in Georgia who can take a project from brand to bytes. Replies typically come within one business day.
Drop me a line - I'm always happy to help with any information you need!
